ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels (scars/lateral patches) to low-intensity black pixels (base pigmentation) estimated at approximately 0.45:0.55 across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region; high-intensity contiguous white patches at both lateral tips. Extensive high-intensity linear and mottled clusters distributed non-uniformly across the dark base pigmentation of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; calculated pixel angle approximately 42 degrees with a high-depth bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible across the entire span from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper margins of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosette-type) localized on the far-left lateral margin and scattered across the central-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense networks of intersecting and parallel high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the visible fluke area, particularly concentrated on the upper lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring (likely orca-induced) across both lobes; irregular jagged notches on the trailing edge consistent with prior physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density overlapping of linear and rosette scarring patterns creating a complex, high-entropy texture that obscures much of the natural dark pigmentation.
